# Ewaste Kochi

Canonical site: https://www.ewastekochi.com

Ewaste Kochi provides e-waste recycling, electronics pickup, battery
recycling, IT asset disposition (ITAD), data destruction, hard drive
shredding, computer scrap buying, server recycling, and sell-old-electronics
services for Kochi, Ernakulam, and Kerala, India. Content is available in
English and, for a starter set of pages, Malayalam (ml-IN) under /ml/.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

This site is under active reconstruction (EwasteKochi V2). The pages above
represent the key current build surfaces as of Indexed Blog URL Expansion (2026-07-18). The
/blog/ sitemap contains 124 live guide URLs, including expanded pillar guides for
pickup, battery recycling, selling electronics, data destruction, ITAD, TV and
monitor recycling, mobile phones, laptop/computer recycling, printers and
peripherals, scrap-price guidance, preparation/safety and corporate e-waste,
plus safe refreshed pages for clean indexed legacy `/blog/` URLs that appeared
in the GSC/top-pages exports. The full canonical URL set is exported in
content-index.json and the sitemap index.
The blog is organised across a 20-cluster content roadmap (src/data/blogRoadmap20.ts). Most
roadmap topics remain planning data only, with no live page yet. A larger,
programmatically assembled batch of 465 posts was built and then
deliberately withheld from indexing after an internal audit found excessive
verbatim content reuse between them; those drafts, plus 90 further
individually-drafted-but-unreviewed posts, are quarantined outside the build
(.content-quarantine/blog-drafts/) pending individual review and promotion
one at a time — see reports/blog-scale-safety-gate-report.md. Only the pages
listed above are
canonical. Treat any other path on this domain as not yet confirmed
canonical.

Last updated: 2026-07-18
